name: dramatic-cool-male-portrait
image_purpose: male identity, necklace, backpack, and dramatic lighting reference

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic close-up selfie of an approved adult man indoors under dramatic overhead lighting.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult man with tousled blond hair, light eyes, natural skin texture, black opaque tank top, black backpack strap, and cord necklace with a simple tooth-shaped pendant.
prompt.composition_elements: Slightly tilted downward extended-arm selfie, direct serious gaze, minimal dark background with exposed ceiling beams and bright overhead light, sharp facial detail and natural shoulders.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic overhead light, subtle glow and contrast, modern dark lifestyle mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone portrait, vertical 4:5, 50mm look, shallow depth of field, high dynamic range, natural pores and hair detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult man with tousled blond hair and light eyes takes an ultra-realistic close-up selfie indoors, wearing a black opaque tank top, backpack strap, and simple tooth-shaped pendant. Use a slight downward arm perspective, exposed ceiling beams, bright overhead light, dramatic contrast, natural skin, and sharp facial detail.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed hands, plastic skin, harsh clipping, blurry face, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
